system.description:
Sundered Dwarf

Sundered dwarves are those who have lost their ancestral mountain holds to orcs, dragons, or other catastrophic forces, and have since wandered the surface world in exile. Rather than a distinct subrace, sundered dwarves are mountain or hill dwarves who have adapted to a homeless, nomadic existence. Generations of surface wandering have given them broader worldly experience than their hold-dwelling kin, and they tend to be somewhat less insular. Their hearts remain tied to the stone, however, and they dream ceaselessly of reclaiming their ancestral home.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Constitution: +1
  • Charisma: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Detect Stonework: As mountain dwarf — detect grade on 1–5 in d6; new construction on 1–5; sliding walls on 1–4; stonework traps on 1–3; depth underground on 1–3.
  • Attack Bonus: +1 to attack rolls vs. orcs, half-orcs, goblins, and hobgoblins.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. giants, ogres, trolls, ogre magi, and titans.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +1 per 3.5 points of Constitution vs. magic and poison.
  • World-Weary: Sundered dwarves have broader experience than other dwarves. They gain one extra non-weapon proficiency at character creation reflecting their wandering experience.
  • Wanderer's Resilience: Sundered dwarves receive a +1 bonus to Survival non-weapon proficiency checks in non-underground environments.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Cleric, Fighter/Thief multiclass.
